name: antigravity-flow
description: Operate Google Flow (flow.google.com) through Antigravity's built-in browser: plan storyboards, manage Characters and Ingredients, generate Omni/Veo shots, assemble Scenes, run or build Flow Tools, and keep skills synced with live Flow updates.
suggestedPrompts: Plan a 4-shot sci-fi short film storyboard for Google Flow with consistent Characters and Ingredients
Batch generate all shots from storyboard.md in Google Flow in full-auto mode and assemble them into a Scene
/flow-sync — audit the live Google Flow web UI to add new features and prune deprecated models
